# ANTIGRAVITY EXECUTIVE DIRECTIVE — DIR-094
## Platform-Wide End-to-End UI/UX Forensic Enhancement, Visual Layout Blueprinting, and Iterative Parity Convergence Engine

**Standard ID:** AEDS-001  
**Target Project:** IME365 — Interview Made Easy  
**Required Workspace:** `D:\xampp\htdocs\IME365`  
**Directive ID:** `DIR-094`  
**Priority:** P0 — Critical  
**Mode:** PLAN ONLY — Read-Only Investigation & Visual Blueprinting  
**Status:** ISSUED — Awaiting Architecture Plan & Visual Layout Blueprint  
**Execution Authority:** Inspection, architectural mapping, and plan submission only. Code implementation is strictly prohibited in this phase.

---

# SECTION 1 — EXECUTIVE MANDATE

Execute a comprehensive, platform-wide end-to-end UI/UX forensic enhancement across all pages, subpages, sections, and element styling throughout IME365 to deliver a world-class, 10/10 Cuba Modern Executive experience.

The developer must propose an implementation plan featuring structured page layout blueprints, visual hierarchy mappings, and reference parity specifications. The implementation lifecycle must strictly follow the iterative convergence protocol:
CODE -> REVIEW -> RATE -> PARITY CHECK -> REITERATE TILL 100%

Every interactive element, filter, modal, drawer, form, and navigation path must be 100% operational with zero dead controls, zero broken journeys, and zero duplicate components or repeated metric cards.

---

# SECTION 2 — ABSOLUTE MODE RESTRICTIONS: PLAN MODE VS ACT MODE

### 2.1 PLAN MODE (Current Phase — Strictly Read-Only)
- Permitted: Source inspection, component hierarchy mapping, route discovery, layout blueprint design, test suite inspection, and Bridge plan submission (bridge dev plan).
- Prohibited: Modifying code, altering stylesheets, installing packages, executing git commits/resets, writing to databases, or touching src/cv-templates/.

### 2.2 ACT MODE (Authorized Only Upon Lead Plan Approval)
- Permitted only after Lead approval (Cloud AI score >= 70/100).
- Authorizes surgical code enhancements, Cuba token unification, deduplication, responsive styling, and Playwright DOM crawls.

---

# SECTION 3 — PRE-FLIGHT REPOSITORY AND WORKSPACE VERIFICATION

1. Verified Target Path: D:\xampp\htdocs\IME365
2. Active Branch: arena/f4651d36-resumepilotai
3. Current HEAD SHA: 0aa523e3
4. Working Tree Integrity: Zero uncommitted application code changes. Preserve existing user work.
5. Toolchain Discovery: Node.js, Vite build (npm run build), ESLint (npm run lint), and Playwright test suite (test:design-system, tests/copilot-command-surface.test.mjs, etc.).

---

# SECTION 4 — NON-NEGOTIABLE PROJECT INVARIANTS

1. src/cv-templates/ 100% Frozen: Git diff MUST remain exactly 0 bytes at all times.
2. Zero Fabricated Production Data: All resume fields, candidate names, ATS scores, match percentages, insights, and tracker stages must bind to real database/API state or deterministic calculation engines (calculateAtsScore). Never hardcode mock user names or synthetic progress bars.
3. Strict Cuba Design System Compliance: Unified glassmorphism tokens (--cuba-bg-glass, --cuba-border-glass, subtle backdrop-filter blurs, refined shadows, consistent radii). Zero arbitrary uncurated hex or raw utility overrides.
4. Single-Viewport Bounded Ergonomics: Candidate dashboards must maintain single-viewport operational ergonomics with zero whole-window scrolling regressions.
5. 100% Operational Integrity: Zero dead buttons, dead links, dead tabs, dead route destinations, or unhandled interactions.
6. Zero Redundancy & Deduplication: Eliminate duplicate cards, duplicate metric calls, repeated headlines, or redundant markup.
7. Production Gates: npm run build exits code 0 and ESLint exits with 0 errors.

---

# SECTION 5 — AUTHORITATIVE REFERENCES AND PARITY REQUIREMENTS

### 5.1 Authoritative Reference Assets
- build-resume-target-reference.png: Authoritative 6-region composition for /build-resume (Sidebar, 4-level Breadcrumb, Page Header with ATS gauge & Saved pill, Horizontal Stepper, Main 5/5 editing section, and Right-Rail Career Assistant).
- candidate-dashboard-target-reference.png: Target candidate HUD layout.
- test-results/cuba-audit-screenshots/: Comprehensive 15-view reference library for all candidate suite subpages (Overview, Resumes, Cover Letters, Portfolios, Favorites, Notifications, Jobs, Tracker, Applied, Interview, Messages, Plans, Profile, Security, Support).

### 5.2 7-Tier Precedence Hierarchy
Security/Privacy > Project Invariants > Domain Contracts > Functional Requirements > Authoritative Visual References > Project Conventions > Defaults.

---

# SECTION 6 — MANDATORY PLATFORM-WIDE INVESTIGATION & COVERAGE

Discover and map the complete component and route hierarchy:
1. Candidate Workspaces (15 Subpages):
   - Overview HUD, Resumes List & Grid, Cover Letters, Portfolios & Builder, Job Search & Filters, Application Tracker, Applied Jobs Pipeline, AI Interview Coach & CBT Simulator, Direct Messages, Notifications & Activity, Profile & Skills, Security & MFA, Plans & Billing, and Support.
2. Public & Discovery Pages:
   - Landing / Hero, Feature Showcase, 51-Template Showcase, Pricing & Plans, FAQs, Career Resources, Blog Reader, Job Listings & Details, Auth Flow (Login, Register, Reset).
3. Global Chrome & Navigation:
   - Top Header, Collapsible Sidebar, Right-Rail Assistant, Command Palette, Modals, Drawers, and Floating Action Hubs.
4. Interactive Path Tracing:
   - User Action -> Event Handler -> Validation -> State -> Service/API -> UI Feedback.

---

# SECTION 7 — VISUAL QUALITY, RESPONSIVENESS, ACCESSIBILITY, AND NON-FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS

1. Responsive Viewport Matrix:
   - 320px (Mobile Small)
   - 768px (Tablet Portrait)
   - 1280px (Standard Desktop / Laptop)
   - 1440px (Wide Desktop)
   - 1920px (Full HD Display)
2. Accessibility Standards: WCAG 2.1 AA baseline across all pages. Visible keyboard focus rings (--cuba-focus-ring), unique ARIA labels, semantic landmark elements, and contrast ratio >= 4.5:1.
3. Ergonomics & Layout Polish: Perfect spacing scale, typography scale, alignment of icon-text pairs, loading skeleton states, and micro-animations.

---

# SECTION 8 — DATA INTEGRITY, STATE MANAGEMENT, AND EDGE CASES

- Real-data bindings for all candidate metrics, resume fields, and ATS scores.
- Truthful empty states or standard fallback placeholders (e.g. '—') when data is missing or loading.
- Race condition prevention on rapid filter/search toggling.
- Unsaved changes guard on form navigation.
- Safe optimistic updates with automatic rollback on error.

---

# SECTION 9 — TEST STRATEGY AND ACCEPTANCE REQUIREMENTS

### Layered Verification Pipeline
- Layer 1 (Static): npm run build exits 0; ESLint exits 0 errors; git diff -- src/cv-templates/ exits 0 bytes.
- Layer 2 (Unit/Regression): Regression test suites pass: test:dir082, test:dir084, test:dir085, test:dir086, test:dir090, test:dir091, test:dir092, test:dir092-hero, test:dir093, test:dir094, test:dir095, test:design-system (142/142 passing), copilot-command-surface (28/28 passing).
- Layer 3 (Browser E2E): Playwright DOM Interactive Census verifying all interactive controls with 0 unhandled console errors.
- Layer 4 (A11y & Responsive): Zero overflow clipping across all 5 viewports.
- Layer 5 (Release Gate): Acceptance Criteria AC1-AC6 proven with machine-verifiable evidence.

---

# SECTION 10 — REQUIRED FORENSIC & ENGINEERING DELIVERABLES

1. Repository Baseline Report
2. UI/UX Architecture & Layout Blueprint Inventory (Mapping all 15 candidate subpages + public pages)
3. Backend-to-UI Completeness Matrix
4. UI/UX Defect & Redundancy Register (Identifying and purging duplicates)
5. Reference Parity Specification (Covering /build-resume and Candidate Dashboard)
6. Responsive Layout Verification Matrix (320px to 1920px)
7. Implementation Waves Milestone Plan
8. Final UI/UX Completeness & Certification Report

---

# SECTION 11 — SEVERITY, PRIORITIZATION, AND 8-WAVE IMPLEMENTATION SEQUENCING

- Wave 1 (Baseline & Scope): Lock invariants (src/cv-templates/ 0 bytes diff, Cuba tokens). Complete route and component inventory.
- Wave 2 (Critical Correctness & Data Integrity): Fix any dead routes, broken state handlers, or fabricated metrics.
- Wave 3 (Shared Shell & Design System): Unify CubaAppShell, TopNav, Sidebar, Command Palette, and glassmorphism tokens. Eliminate duplicate cards and redundant metric calls.
- Wave 4 (Core Feature Pages): Overhaul Candidate Dashboard subpages (Overview, Resumes, Cover Letters, Portfolios, Jobs, Applications, Interview, Messages, Settings).
- Wave 5 (Resume Builder Reference Parity): Exact 6-region parity with build-resume-target-reference.png.
- Wave 6 (Accessibility & Responsive Viewports): Enforce WCAG 2.1 AA focus rings, ARIA landmarks, and verify 320px, 768px, 1280px, 1440px, 1920px viewports with zero clipping.
- Wave 7 (Edge Cases & Cross-Feature Integration): Unify loading skeletons, empty states, error boundaries, and optimistic autosave rollback.
- Wave 8 (Release Validation & Gatekeeper Certification): Execute full regression suite, Playwright DOM census, build check, lint check, and submit final evidence bundle.

---

# SECTION 12 — REQUIRED FINAL RESPONSE AND COMPLETION REPORT

Every milestone report and completion report must provide:
1. Exact command execution evidence with exit codes.
2. Orthogonal status: Executed - passed vs Blocked.
3. Evidence classification: Verified, Probable, Unverified, Blocked.
4. Git HEAD commit and diff verification (src/cv-templates/ = 0 bytes).
5. Defect resolution log with before/after assertions.

---

# SECTION 13 — MANDATORY BRIDGE PLAN SUBMISSION AND TOOL EXECUTION GOVERNANCE

Developer MUST submit the plan using the following terminal command syntax:

bridge dev plan --directive DIR-094 --projectDir "D:\xampp\htdocs\IME365" --summary "<Evidence-based investigation summary and layout blueprint description>" --steps "S1 Baseline & Inventory;S2 Critical Correctness;S3 Shared Shell & Tokens;S4 Core Feature Pages;S5 Resume Builder Reference Parity;S6 Accessibility & Viewports;S7 Edge Cases & Integration;S8 Release Validation"

The plan will be evaluated autonomously by the Cloud AI Lead Reviewer (NVIDIA Nemotron 120B / OpenRouter 550B) across the 6 architectural dimensions.

---

Investigate first. Propose structured page layouts. Eliminate duplicates. Ensure 100% operational integrity. Iterate through:
CODE -> REVIEW -> RATE -> PARITY CHECK -> REITERATE TILL 100%

No assumption presented as fact. No action beyond authorization. No protected invariant violated. No dead control allowed.

plan.summary: DIR-094 is a read-only forensic UI/UX enhancement and visual-blueprint plan. Recon evidence: candidate chrome is ONE authoritative 28-route table in DashboardMain.renderRoutes() with 14 nav destinations in candidateNavigation.js; 2542 legacy Tailwind palette utilities remain across candidate/dashboard surfaces (DashboardInterviews 803, LiveInterviewSession 398, DashboardSupport 190, ProfileDisplay 188, AddCompanyModal 126, DashboardHomepage 125, EmployerDashboard 105, CompaniesManagement 98, EditJobModal 91); 43 TODO/FIXME/HACK markers. Two findings change the approach. (1) AC5 names --cuba-bg-glass and --cuba-border-glass which DO NOT EXIST in src/styles/cuba-tokens.css; the real tokens are --cuba-glass-bg, --cuba-glass-bg-strong, --cuba-glass-border, --cuba-glass-blur and --cuba-glass-shadow plus dark variants, so AC5 will be met by mapping onto the existing 376-token system with ZERO new parallel tokens. (2) The DIR-094 test id is already occupied by tests/dir094-candidate-dashboard-analytics.test.mjs and npm run test:dir094 from an earlier DIR-094, so new suites will use distinct file names and scripts. No live browser render is possible (XAMPP policy forbids spawning dev servers, and /dashboard requires i18n, router and auth providers), so blueprints are derived from the real route table, component source and emitted CSS, with the Playwright DOM census executed in the implementation phase. src/cv-templates remains frozen at a 0-byte diff.
